name: faithtube
description: FaithTube — Every Video. Christ-Centered. A dedicated Christian video platform.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @faithtube/server" "npm run dev -w @faithtube/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @faithtube/server && npm run build -w @faithtube/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run bootstrap && npm run build:shared && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @faithtube/shared && npm run typecheck -w @faithtube/server && npm run typecheck -w @faithtube/web
